definition: Mustafa Suleyman (born in August 1984) is a British artificial intelligence (AI) entrepreneur.
details: He is the CEO of Microsoft AI, and the co-founder and former head of applied AI at DeepMind, an AI company which was acquired by Google. After leaving DeepMind, he co-founded Inflection AI, a machine learning and generative AI company, in 2022.
